name: permitio
description: Node.js client library for the Permit.io full-stack permissions platform

scripts.build: pnpm run build:js && pnpm run build:types
scripts.lint: pnpm run lint:oxlint && pnpm run lint:format && pnpm run lint:types
scripts.test: pnpm run build && vitest run --project unit --project module-imports
scripts.test:module-imports: pnpm run build && vitest run --project module-imports
scripts.generate-openapi-client: openapi-generator-cli generate -i https://api.permit.io/v2/openapi.json -g typescript-axios -o src/openapi/ --additional-properties=useSingleRequestParameter=true,withSeparateModelsAndApi=true,apiPackage=api,modelPackage=types --skip-validate-spec && pnpm run normalize:openapi
scripts.test:codegen: pnpm run build && vitest run --project codegen
scripts.verify: pnpm exec prek run --config .pre-commit-config.yaml --all-files && pnpm run build && vitest run --project unit --project module-imports --project codegen
